title: 8 beauty finds from my last trip to Korea that you can now get in the U.S
caption: 8 beauty finds from my last trip to Korea that you can now get in the U.S. 1. [Lilybyred] Smiley Lip Blending Stick (02 Smiley) — Perfect for overlining. I blend it just past my upper lip line for a subtle boost. 2. [Baren] Non-Slip Shea Butter Sleeping Heel Patches — Shea butter patches that stick right onto dry heels before bed. 3. [Rom&nd] Better Than Palette (03 Pampas Garden) — Soft peachy shades for daytime, extra sparkle for a night out, and the darkest shade doubles as eyeliner. 4. [Tony Moly] Makeup Brush Set — The little case keeps my brushes from rolling around loose in my makeup bag. 5. [Banila Co] Clean It Zero Original Cleansing Balm Travel Kit — Individually packed cleansing balm for trips. I pack one packet for every 2 nights. 6. [Mediheal] Essential Mask — I pick by ingredient. My favorites are Vitamin C (brightening), Rose PDRN (pore tightening), and Ceramide (moisture barrier) 7. [ATOPALM] Soothing Gel Lotion — Lightweight, easy to spread, and I share it with my 4-year-old. 8. [Eclado] Golden Sandalwood Gua Sha — My favorite is a scalp massage at the end of the day. It feels so good along my jawline and neck, too. Comment “K-BEAUTY” or tap the link in my bio to shop. 🤍
